ops.description:
Owner /root/ccn_bounded_cache. Root assigned the residual selected-task point-read latency after the accepted official28 install: natural metadata readback1.515575459s, separate original answer1.189710167s. One already-authorized Time Profiler capture of the selected cache task completed naturally; no replay/new measurement is requested.

Retained FE/ccn7428-selected-task-profile: target15745 exit0/recorder15237 exit0, releasecfa16165. Exact public28 b097/UUID1DEEDC2A symbolization offline-functions.json shows showTask -> TasksBlocking -> IndexedTasksBlocking -> readQueryMetadataIndex; PinnedKinds packed refs capture, bbolt diff and apply. Startup init7.415ms and one native rev-parse11.353ms do not explain earlier1.515s. Inclusive row counts are not percentages;7fullfsync rows have no higher Go caller, so physical-cause attribution UNKNOWN. Task state changed before profile; current2.707s recording does not reproduce old1.515s.

Source: notes/index.go13-29@1383 reverse TasksBlocking membership cannot validate only already-known IDs. query_index.go23-220 performs full-kind authority capture/diff on generation miss; query_delta.go87-176 scans metadata and recomputes in writable transaction. Naive equal-tx-ID cross-open delta reuse was refuted: replacement DB can share tx ID. No unsafe shortcut/NoSync/source change. Next executable step: independently reviewed minimal existing-source optimization with exact authority/replacement/cancel parity and32/10k work gate, then actual delivery. Q150 native COMMON counter is a separate steady-state partial solution (actual Mac rapid test PASS), not total first-mutation constant-work proof. Urgent152/official30 duplicate restoration delivery preempts optimization.

ops.text: Exact retained profile and source establish reachable capture/diff/apply work without attributing uncontrolled timing or unresolved fullfsync.
Independent-review candidate preserves reverse membership, pinning, external writers, DB replacement, cancellation and errors; actual32/10000 parity and work gates pass.
Fix is merged, officially published/installed and a single authorized selected-task affected case verifies latency; no universal or physical-IO claim.
